name: Sunwalk
body:
School transmutation [light]; Level arcanist 7, cleric 7, druid 7, oracle 7, sorcerer 7, wizard 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Targets up to one touched creature/level
Duration 1 hour/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

To use the sunwalk spell, you must be in an area of dim light or brighter. You and any creatures you touch are then transformed into motes of light and travel across its beams.

During this spell, your form is Diminutive and insubstantial. You cannot take any actions while this spell is in effect, except to travel or dismiss the spell. You can travel only through areas of dim light or brighter, and likewise you can dismiss the spell and thus end your travel only in an area of dim light or brighter. While sunwalking, you can travel with a speed of up to 100 miles per hour and remain entirely aware of your surroundings. You are considered incorporeal for the purpose of your AC and how various effects affect you, but you cannot pass through solid barriers. If you are forced into an area darker than dim light during this spell, it ends instantly for you (but not other creatures affected) and you are shunted into the nearest area of dim light or brighter that is not entirely encased by solid barriers and is big enough to contain you. If that place is farther than 1000 feet away, you are fatigued (no save).

While this spell is in effect, you are immune to blindness, critical hits, ability score damage, deafness, disease, drowning, electricity, poison, stunning, and all spells or attacks that affect your physiology or respiration, because you have no physiology or respiration while this spell is in effect.

Dismissing this spell is a full-round action and only affects the creature dismissing the spell. Every creature affected by sunwalk can dismiss the spell by themselves.
